# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:

All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Review Guidelines — evaluate against existing codebase patterns"] G2["Before reviewing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists → READ it — defines coding styles to check against"] G4["Flag deviations from established patterns unless justified in PR description"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 ``` # PR Review General Guidelines ## Review flow ```mermaid flowchart TD START([PR ready for review]) --> READ["1. instruction.md, ticket.md, pr_info.md,

re-read changed files,
surface ALL remaining issues"] EXHAUST --> OUTPUT["8. Write outputs:
pr_review.json · pr_review_general.md · pr_review_comments/*.md"] OUTPUT --> END([End]) ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Changed-file deep read Do not review from the diff alone. Read the full content of every changed file: - imports and dependencies - class/method responsibilities and adherence to SRP / OOP principles - naming consistency with the rest of the codebase - error handling, logging, and edge cases - test coverage for changed behavior - backward-compatibility and migration impact ## 4. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. # Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1565
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1565
- **Title**: test(1259): ratchet CLI coverage baseline to 17.96 + behavior tests for 8 untested lib/src/cli modules
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `test/1259-coverage-ratchet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +730
- **Deletions**: -1
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:49:53Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T10:49:53Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1259

## What
Per the issue body (the weekly gardener's #927 contract), two things land here:

1. **Baseline ratchet: `scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt` 15.69 → 17.96** — the gardener's measured line coverage of `lib/src/cli/**` on main. Per #927 the baseline never auto-commits; it moves only through this reviewed PR. Nothing else measurement-related is touched (no check_coverage.py thresholds, no crap4dart baselines, no CI configs).
2. **8 new pure-Dart behavior test files** for previously-untested `lib/src/cli/` modules — 729 lines, repo test bar: observable behavior, boundaries, invariants, real error paths; no padding, no source-text assertions.

## #927 trace: where 15.69 → 17.96 comes from
The bump predates this PR — it is the gardener's measurement of main's `dart test --tags integration` line coverage of `lib/src/cli/**`, grown by PTY suites merged since the last baseline raise (3a71583c5, #1028; 42 commits touched `test/integration/` since). Suite-level trace — the frame-assertion PTY suites added or materially expanded since #1028:

- #1306 (0d9f42bd) — PTY boot-once harness: toolchain+boot paid once per shard — the multiplier that made broad PTY frame coverage cheap
- #1420 (gh-1415) — subagent status line: ten named frame deltas in the CLI TUI
- #1443 (gh-1439) — follow-mode contract + «jump to live» TUI frames
- #1427 (gh-1425) — fold projection resume-equivalence frames
- #1428 (gh-1409) — compaction-pinned skill operative lines surviving folds
- #1437 (gh-1433) — headless log fidelity: thinking deltas AND assistant text render
- #1376 + #1419 (feat 1374) — animated two-tone kaomoji thinking indicator (CLI TUI + app/web TUI)
- #1325 (fix 1323) — live thinking streams in the TUI (transient-retry attempt frames)
- #1231 (fix 918) — omp_ref reference fixtures captured on a PTY host + nerd-glyph parity
- #1263 (gh-1197) — recovered TUI dev leg
- #1353 (fix 1348) — viewport-bottom submit anchor
- #1113 (d850e7b9) — `fa wire-serve` E2E over WS/NDJSON

Excluded from the trace on purpose: `composer_echo_pty`, `pty_resume_equivalence`, `header_badge_pty` were quarantined out of the gate (#1414, #1423, #1470) — quarantined suites do not run, so they contribute nothing. Per-line attribution is exactly what the per-PR `pty-integration-linux` + `pty-coverage-gate` legs compute authoritatively.

## New tests — module → what each defends
| Module (lib/src/cli/) | Tests defend |
|---|---|
| `text_format.dart` | `formatArgs` 100-col cap boundary (exactly 100 untouched; 101+ → 100 chars + `...`), JSON value quoting; `safeJsonEncode` never throws — cyclic/unserializable → `[unserializable]`, lossless vs `jsonEncode` otherwise |
| `output_config.dart` | strict `output:` parser: non-map, unknown key, non-bool each throw `ConfigException` (a typo must never silently keep the default); `streamThinking` is true only when explicitly true |
| `pi_mode.dart` | AC3 precedence flag > env > config; repo truthy-env convention (case/trim; `0`/empty/null falsy); unknown `agent.mode` throws naming the value and the `default\|pi` set; `piToolsOverride` pins every known tool id to `piToolIds` membership and cannot grant unknown tools |
| `tui_mouse_mode.dart` | parse boundaries: `1/true/yes/on` → on, `0/false/no` → off, null/empty/`y`/`enabled` → auto (default) |
| `ask_menu.dart` | header + 1-based progress suffix only when total > 1; `(Recommended)` on exactly the recommended row; blank description renders like none; `pickedLabel` sorted, 1-based, `-` when empty |
| `browser_bridge_commands.dart` | null handle → clean unavailable note on every subcommand; unknown subcommand and non-numeric port refused BEFORE any connect (fake handle counts calls); port/`--copy-keys` pass through to the handle; already-running vs started wording; a throwing connect surfaces a line, not a crash; status renders endpoint/extensions/mailboxes incl. cwd-less rows |
| `links_surface.dart` | block renders all three URLs and the coming-soon slot exactly twice while `play` is unset; live Play link replaces it; config values are attribute-escaped (a hostile link cannot break out of `href`); header badge + hero CTA carry ONLY the paid link with their per-position referral values |
| `provider_tuning_seed.dart` | tuned entry registers and the boot notice pins name, endpoint, sources; endpoint-keyed resolution (request URL under the base → `provider:<name>`, other host → built-in 180s/300s); per-field fallthrough (connect set → idle stays `default`); AC6 fast path (no overrides → never registered); E4 `reset: true` drops removed entries; without reset the seeder adds (boot two-pass) |

## Local gate status — honest disclosure
This host's machine guard SIGKILLs dart VM runs (exit 137). Attempted ONCE from the worktree, as sanctioned: `dart test <the 8 new files>` via the bundled dart-sdk binary (the PATH `dart` is a flutter shim that cannot write its engine stamp on this sandboxed host) → **killed, exit 137**. Nothing was measured locally; no output is faked.

Static fallback applied (the PR#1557 lesson): every import path verified to exist; every referenced symbol grep-verified as defined in its module; directive order verified (imports precede declarations); flutter_test-only matchers removed (`findsNWidgets` → RegExp count — root-package tests stay Flutter-free); one compile error caught and fixed pre-push (`const` on the non-const factory `StoreBannerView.from`). The PR's own CI is the real gate.

## Delivered vs remaining
Delivered: baseline file at 17.96, #927 trace, 8 test files / 729 lines, static gate clean.
Remaining (owner-side by design): the per-PR `pty-integration-linux` + `pty-coverage-gate` runs — SM owns CI scheduling (no workflow dispatch from this lane per fleet policy).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around

  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.

  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.

  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record

Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? # AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +

The bump predates this PR — it is the gardener's measurement of main's `dart test --tags integration` line coverage of `lib/src/cli/**`, grown by PTY suites merged since the last baseline raise (3a71583c5, #1028; 42 commits touched `test/integration/` since). # AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1565
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1565
- **Title**: test(1259): ratchet CLI coverage baseline to 17.96 + behavior tests for 8 untested lib/src/cli modules
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `test/1259-coverage-ratchet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +730
- **Deletions**: -1
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:49:53Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T10:49:53Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1259

## What
Per the issue body (the weekly gardener's #927 contract), two things land here:

1. **Baseline ratchet: `scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt` 15.69 → 17.96** — the gardener's measured line coverage of `lib/src/cli/**` on main. Per #927 the baseline never auto-commits; it moves only through this reviewed PR. Nothing else measurement-related is touched (no check_coverage.py thresholds, no crap4dart baselines, no CI configs).
2. **8 new pure-Dart behavior test files** for previously-untested `lib/src/cli/` modules — 729 lines, repo test bar: observable behavior, boundaries, invariants, real error paths; no padding, no source-text assertions.

## #927 trace: where 15.69 → 17.96 comes from
The bump predates this PR — it is the gardener's measurement of main's `dart test --tags integration` line coverage of `lib/src/cli/**`, grown by PTY suites merged since the last baseline raise (3a71583c5, #1028; 42 commits touched `test/integration/` since). Suite-level trace — the frame-assertion PTY suites added or materially expanded since #1028:

- #1306 (0d9f42bd) — PTY boot-once harness: toolchain+boot paid once per shard — the multiplier that made broad PTY frame coverage cheap
- #1420 (gh-1415) — subagent status line: ten named frame deltas in the CLI TUI
- #1443 (gh-1439) — follow-mode contract + «jump to live» TUI frames
- #1427 (gh-1425) — fold projection resume-equivalence frames
- #1428 (gh-1409) — compaction-pinned skill operative lines surviving folds
- #1437 (gh-1433) — headless log fidelity: thinking deltas AND assistant text render
- #1376 + #1419 (feat 1374) — animated two-tone kaomoji thinking indicator (CLI TUI + app/web TUI)
- #1325 (fix 1323) — live thinking streams in the TUI (transient-retry attempt frames)
- #1231 (fix 918) — omp_ref reference fixtures captured on a PTY host + nerd-glyph parity
- #1263 (gh-1197) — recovered TUI dev leg
- #1353 (fix 1348) — viewport-bottom submit anchor
- #1113 (d850e7b9) — `fa wire-serve` E2E over WS/NDJSON

Excluded from the trace on purpose: `composer_echo_pty`, `pty_resume_equivalence`, `header_badge_pty` were quarantined out of the gate (#1414, #1423, #1470) — quarantined suites do not run, so they contribute nothing. Per-line attribution is exactly what the per-PR `pty-integration-linux` + `pty-coverage-gate` legs compute authoritatively.

## New tests — module → what each defends
| Module (lib/src/cli/) | Tests defend |
|---|---|
| `text_format.dart` | `formatArgs` 100-col cap boundary (exactly 100 untouched; 101+ → 100 chars + `...`), JSON value quoting; `safeJsonEncode` never throws — cyclic/unserializable → `[unserializable]`, lossless vs `jsonEncode` otherwise |
| `output_config.dart` | strict `output:` parser: non-map, unknown key, non-bool each throw `ConfigException` (a typo must never silently keep the default); `streamThinking` is true only when explicitly true |
| `pi_mode.dart` | AC3 precedence flag > env > config; repo truthy-env convention (case/trim; `0`/empty/null falsy); unknown `agent.mode` throws naming the value and the `default\|pi` set; `piToolsOverride` pins every known tool id to `piToolIds` membership and cannot grant unknown tools |
| `tui_mouse_mode.dart` | parse boundaries: `1/true/yes/on` → on, `0/false/no` → off, null/empty/`y`/`enabled` → auto (default) |
| `ask_menu.dart` | header + 1-based progress suffix only when total > 1; `(Recommended)` on exactly the recommended row; blank description renders like none; `pickedLabel` sorted, 1-based, `-` when empty |
| `browser_bridge_commands.dart` | null handle → clean unavailable note on every subcommand; unknown subcommand and non-numeric port refused BEFORE any connect (fake handle counts calls); port/`--copy-keys` pass through to the handle; already-running vs started wording; a throwing connect surfaces a line, not a crash; status renders endpoint/extensions/mailboxes incl. cwd-less rows |
| `links_surface.dart` | block renders all three URLs and the coming-soon slot exactly twice while `play` is unset; live Play link replaces it; config values are attribute-escaped (a hostile link cannot break out of `href`); header badge + hero CTA carry ONLY the paid link with their per-position referral values |
| `provider_tuning_seed.dart` | tuned entry registers and the boot notice pins name, endpoint, sources; endpoint-keyed resolution (request URL under the base → `provider:<name>`, other host → built-in 180s/300s); per-field fallthrough (connect set → idle stays `default`); AC6 fast path (no overrides → never registered); E4 `reset: true` drops removed entries; without reset the seeder adds (boot two-pass) |

## Local gate status — honest disclosure
This host's machine guard SIGKILLs dart VM runs (exit 137). Attempted ONCE from the worktree, as sanctioned: `dart test <the 8 new files>` via the bundled dart-sdk binary (the PATH `dart` is a flutter shim that cannot write its engine stamp on this sandboxed host) → **killed, exit 137**. Nothing was measured locally; no output is faked.

Static fallback applied (the PR#1557 lesson): every import path verified to exist; every referenced symbol grep-verified as defined in its module; directive order verified (imports precede declarations); flutter_test-only matchers removed (`findsNWidgets` → RegExp count — root-package tests stay Flutter-free); one compile error caught and fixed pre-push (`const` on the non-const factory `StoreBannerView.from`). The PR's own CI is the real gate.

## Delivered vs remaining
Delivered: baseline file at 17.96, #927 trace, 8 test files / 729 lines, static gate clean.
Remaining (owner-side by design): the per-PR `pty-integration-linux` + `pty-coverage-gate` runs — SM owns CI scheduling (no workflow dispatch from this lane per fleet policy).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify against requirements. ## 2. Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. ## PR Description

Fixes #1259

## What
Per the issue body (the weekly gardener's #927 contract), two things land here:

1. **Baseline ratchet: `scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt` 15.69 → 17.96** — the gardener's measured line coverage of `lib/src/cli/**` on main. Per #927 the baseline never auto-commits; it moves only through this reviewed PR. Nothing else measurement-related is touched (no check_coverage.py thresholds, no crap4dart baselines, no CI configs).
2. **8 new pure-Dart behavior test files** for previously-untested `lib/src/cli/` modules — 729 lines, repo test bar: observable behavior, boundaries, invariants, real error paths; no padding, no source-text assertions.

## #927 trace: where 15.69 → 17.96 comes from
The bump predates this PR — it is the gardener's measurement of main's `dart test --tags integration` line coverage of `lib/src/cli/**`, grown by PTY suites merged since the last baseline raise (3a71583c5, #1028; 42 commits touched `test/integration/` since). Suite-level trace — the frame-assertion PTY suites added or materially expanded since #1028:

- #1306 (0d9f42bd) — PTY boot-once harness: toolchain+boot paid once per shard — the multiplier that made broad PTY frame coverage cheap
- #1420 (gh-1415) — subagent status line: ten named frame deltas in the CLI TUI
- #1443 (gh-1439) — follow-mode contract + «jump to live» TUI frames
- #1427 (gh-1425) — fold projection resume-equivalence frames
- #1428 (gh-1409) — compaction-pinned skill operative lines surviving folds
- #1437 (gh-1433) — headless log fidelity: thinking deltas AND assistant text render
- #1376 + #1419 (feat 1374) — animated two-tone kaomoji thinking indicator (CLI TUI + app/web TUI)
- #1325 (fix 1323) — live thinking streams in the TUI (transient-retry attempt frames)
- #1231 (fix 918) — omp_ref reference fixtures captured on a PTY host + nerd-glyph parity
- #1263 (gh-1197) — recovered TUI dev leg
- #1353 (fix 1348) — viewport-bottom submit anchor
- #1113 (d850e7b9) — `fa wire-serve` E2E over WS/NDJSON

Excluded from the trace on purpose: `composer_echo_pty`, `pty_resume_equivalence`, `header_badge_pty` were quarantined out of the gate (#1414, #1423, #1470) — quarantined suites do not run, so they contribute nothing. Per-line attribution is exactly what the per-PR `pty-integration-linux` + `pty-coverage-gate` legs compute authoritatively.

## New tests — module → what each defends
| Module (lib/src/cli/) | Tests defend |
|---|---|
| `text_format.dart` | `formatArgs` 100-col cap boundary (exactly 100 untouched; 101+ → 100 chars + `...`), JSON value quoting; `safeJsonEncode` never throws — cyclic/unserializable → `[unserializable]`, lossless vs `jsonEncode` otherwise |
| `output_config.dart` | strict `output:` parser: non-map, unknown key, non-bool each throw `ConfigException` (a typo must never silently keep the default); `streamThinking` is true only when explicitly true |
| `pi_mode.dart` | AC3 precedence flag > env > config; repo truthy-env convention (case/trim; `0`/empty/null falsy); unknown `agent.mode` throws naming the value and the `default\|pi` set; `piToolsOverride` pins every known tool id to `piToolIds` membership and cannot grant unknown tools |
| `tui_mouse_mode.dart` | parse boundaries: `1/true/yes/on` → on, `0/false/no` → off, null/empty/`y`/`enabled` → auto (default) |
| `ask_menu.dart` | header + 1-based progress suffix only when total > 1; `(Recommended)` on exactly the recommended row; blank description renders like none; `pickedLabel` sorted, 1-based, `-` when empty |

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate

## PR Description

Fixes #1259

## What
Per the issue body (the weekly gardener's #927 contract), two things land here:

1. **Baseline ratchet: `scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt` 15.69 → 17.96** — the gardener's measured line coverage of `lib/src/cli/**` on main. Per #927 the baseline never auto-commits; it moves only through this reviewed PR. Nothing else measurement-related is touched (no check_coverage.py thresholds, no crap4dart baselines, no CI configs).
2. **8 new pure-Dart behavior test files** for previously-untested `lib/src/cli/` modules — 729 lines, repo test bar: observable behavior, boundaries, invariants, real error paths; no padding, no source-text assertions.

## #927 trace: where 15.69 → 17.96 comes from
The bump predates this PR — it is the gardener's measurement of main's `dart test --tags integration` line coverage of `lib/src/cli/**`, grown by PTY suites merged since the last baseline raise (3a71583c5, #1028; 42 commits touched `test/integration/` since). Suite-level trace — the frame-assertion PTY suites added or materially expanded since #1028:

- #1306 (0d9f42bd) — PTY boot-once harness: toolchain+boot paid once per shard — the multiplier that made broad PTY frame coverage cheap
- #1420 (gh-1415) — subagent status line: ten named frame deltas in the CLI TUI
- #1443 (gh-1439) — follow-mode contract + «jump to live» TUI frames
- #1427 (gh-1425) — fold projection resume-equivalence frames
- #1428 (gh-1409) — compaction-pinned skill operative lines surviving folds
- #1437 (gh-1433) — headless log fidelity: thinking deltas AND assistant text render
- #1376 + #1419 (feat 1374) — animated two-tone kaomoji thinking indicator (CLI TUI + app/web TUI)
- #1325 (fix 1323) — live thinking streams in the TUI (transient-retry attempt frames)
- #1231 (fix 918) — omp_ref reference fixtures captured on a PTY host + nerd-glyph parity
- #1263 (gh-1197) — recovered TUI dev leg
- #1353 (fix 1348) — viewport-bottom submit anchor
- #1113 (d850e7b9) — `fa wire-serve` E2E over WS/NDJSON

Excluded from the trace on purpose: `composer_echo_pty`, `pty_resume_equivalence`, `header_badge_pty` were quarantined out of the gate (#1414, #1423, #1470) — quarantined suites do not run, so they contribute nothing. Per-line attribution is exactly what the per-PR `pty-integration-linux` + `pty-coverage-gate` legs compute authoritatively.

## New tests — module → what each defends
| Module (lib/src/cli/) | Tests defend |
|---|---|
| `text_format.dart` | `formatArgs` 100-col cap boundary (exactly 100 untouched; 101+ → 100 chars + `...`), JSON value quoting; `safeJsonEncode` never throws — cyclic/unserializable → `[unserializable]`, lossless vs `jsonEncode` otherwise |
| `output_config.dart` | strict `output:` parser: non-map, unknown key, non-bool each throw `ConfigException` (a typo must never silently keep the default); `streamThinking` is true only when explicitly true |
| `pi_mode.dart` | AC3 precedence flag > env > config; repo truthy-env convention (case/trim; `0`/empty/null falsy); unknown `agent.mode` throws naming the value and the `default\|pi` set; `piToolsOverride` pins every known tool id to `piToolIds` membership and cannot grant unknown tools |
| `tui_mouse_mode.dart` | parse boundaries: `1/true/yes/on` → on, `0/false/no` → off, null/empty/`y`/`enabled` → auto (default) |
| `ask_menu.dart` | header + 1-based progress suffix only when total > 1; `(Recommended)` on exactly the recommended row; blank description renders like none; `pickedLabel` sorted, 1-based, `-` when empty |
| `browser_bridge_commands.dart` | null handle → clean unavailable note on every subcommand; unknown subcommand and non-numeric port refused BEFORE any connect (fake handle counts calls); port/`--copy-keys` pass through to the handle; already-running vs started wording; a throwing connect surfaces a line, not a crash; status renders endpoint/extensions/mailboxes incl. cwd-less rows |
| `links_surface.dart` | block renders all three URLs and the coming-soon slot exactly twice while `play` is unset; live Play link replaces it; config values are attribute-escaped (a hostile link cannot break out of `href`); header badge + hero CTA carry ONLY the paid link with their per-position referral values |
| `provider_tuning_seed.dart` | tuned entry registers and the boot notice pins name, endpoint, sources; endpoint-keyed resolution (request URL under the base → `provider:<name>`, other host → built-in 180s/300s); per-field fallthrough (connect set → idle stays `default`); AC6 fast path (no overrides → never registered); E4 `reset: true` drops removed entries; without reset the seeder adds (boot two-pass) |

## Local gate status — honest disclosure
This host's machine guard SIGKILLs dart VM runs (exit 137). Attempted ONCE from the worktree, as sanctioned: `dart test <the 8 new files>` via the bundled dart-sdk binary (the PATH `dart` is a flutter shim that cannot write its engine stamp on this sandboxed host) → **killed, exit 137**. Nothing was measured locally; no output is faked.

Static fallback applied (the PR#1557 lesson): every import path verified to exist; every referenced symbol grep-verified as defined in its module; directive order verified (imports precede declarations); flutter_test-only matchers removed (`findsNWidgets` → RegExp count — root-package tests stay Flutter-free); one compile error caught and fixed pre-push (`const` on the non-const factory `StoreBannerView.from`). The PR's own CI is the real gate.

## Delivered vs remaining
Delivered: baseline file at 17.96, #927 trace, 8 test files / 729 lines, static gate clean.
Remaining (owner-side by design): the per-PR `pty-integration-linux` + `pty-coverage-gate` runs — SM owns CI scheduling (no workflow dispatch from this lane per fleet policy).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
  (never replaces), so injected vars keep the inherited environment.
- `lib/src/env/io_execution_env.dart` — `LocalShell`: foreground `exec`
  runs under `setsid` when the host has it (probe
  `ownProcessGroupAvailable`, seam `ownProcessGroupOverride`) and the
  timeout/cancel paths reap the whole tree (`killTree` + direct-kill
  backstop) with a capped pipe-drain (`_drainGrace`) — timeout/cancel'd
  calls complete in ≤ timeout + kill grace + drain grace; a no-timeout
  call within `_drainGrace` of the direct child's exit (the drain is
  capped unconditionally: after the child is reaped every remaining pipe
  byte comes from an orphan). Killed calls are marked `timeout`/`aborted`
  and carry the captured partial output on `ExecutionError.stdout`/
  `stderr` — tail-capped at the source to the last 64 KiB (`_captureTail`)
  — rendered by the bash tool and the skill renderer's `!cmd` failure
  branch (every string that branch embeds is tail-capped to ~2 KB)
  (gh-1053; the timeout timer stays
  armed after the child exits because an orphaned descendant can hold
  the pipes — a drain that outlives the deadline marks the call
  `timedOut` even when the child exited 0). Background jobs (issue #517)
  keep their own group + `stop()` semantics.
- `lib/src/tools/checkpoint_tool.dart` — `checkpoint`/`rewind` tools:
  context hygiene for detours. `CheckpointRewindController` wraps
  `Agent.prepareNextTurn`, persists via host `CheckpointSessionSink`.
  Lifecycle (issue #286): a checkpoint is scoped to its detour — when the
  next `checkpoint` call finds it stale (a user turn arrived inside the
  detour, or the anchored span was rebuilt away by reload/compaction), it
  is auto-closed with a note + `checkpoint_auto_closed` session record
  instead of refusing; `rewind` semantics are unchanged.
- `lib/src/compaction/branch_summarization.dart` — `generateBranchSummary` +
  `navigateSessionTree` (use instead of `Session.moveTo` for tree
  navigation); summary is a `branch_summary` record on the entered branch.
- `lib/src/agent/tool_pairing.dart` — context pair-integrity (issue #85):
  `validateToolPairing` checks the wire-equivalent message sequence (orphan
  results, unanswered calls, duplicate ids, displaced results after
  same-role merges); `repairToolPairing` fixes the outbound payload only
  (drop orphan + one-shot note, synthesize interrupted results, hoist
  steering text after results, uniquify duplicate ids symmetrically on
  call+result). gh-1449: the drop note never costs the model a turn — it
  rides the payload's LAST existing user message as an extra text block
  (degenerate no-user-message payload degrades to the legacy standalone
  note), names tool/id/cut/kept-in-summary, and fires ONCE per orphan:

    #

    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),

    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,

    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.

- **PR #**: 1565
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1565
- **Title**: test(1259): ratchet CLI coverage baseline to 17.96 + behavior tests for 8 untested lib/src/cli modules
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `test/1259-coverage-ratchet` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 9
- **Additions**: +730
- **Deletions**: -1
- **Created**: 2026-10-12T10:49:53Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-12T10:49:53Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1259

## What
Per the issue body (the weekly gardener's #927 contract), two things land here:

1. **Baseline ratchet: `scripts/cli_coverage_baseline.txt` 15.69 → 17.96** — the gardener's measured line coverage of `lib/src/cli/**` on main. Per #927 the baseline never auto-commits; it moves only through this reviewed PR. Nothing else measurement-related is touched (no check_coverage.py thresholds, no crap4dart baselines, no CI configs).
2. **8 new pure-Dart behavior test files** for previously-untested `lib/src/cli/` modules — 729 lines, repo test bar: observable behavior, boundaries, invariants, real error paths; no padding, no source-text assertions.

## #927 trace: where 15.69 → 17.96 comes from
The bump predates this PR — it is the gardener's measurement of main's `dart test --tags integration` line coverage of `lib/src/cli/**`, grown by PTY suites merged since the last baseline raise (3a71583c5, #1028; 42 commits touched `test/integration/` since). Suite-level trace — the frame-assertion PTY suites added or materially expanded since #1028:

- #1306 (0d9f42bd) — PTY boot-once harness: toolchain+boot paid once per shard — the multiplier that made broad PTY frame coverage cheap
- #1420 (gh-1415) — subagent status line: ten named frame deltas in the CLI TUI
- #1443 (gh-1439) — follow-mode contract + «jump to live» TUI frames
- #1427 (gh-1425) — fold projection resume-equivalence frames
- #1428 (gh-1409) — compaction-pinned skill operative lines surviving folds
- #1437 (gh-1433) — headless log fidelity: thinking deltas AND assistant text render
- #1376 + #1419 (feat 1374) — animated two-tone kaomoji thinking indicator (CLI TUI + app/web TUI)
- #1325 (fix 1323) — live thinking streams in the TUI (transient-retry attempt frames)
- #1231 (fix 918) — omp_ref reference fixtures captured on a PTY host + nerd-glyph parity
- #1263 (gh-1197) — recovered TUI dev leg
- #1353 (fix 1348) — viewport-bottom submit anchor
- #1113 (d850e7b9) — `fa wire-serve` E2E over WS/NDJSON

Excluded from the trace on purpose: `composer_echo_pty`, `pty_resume_equivalence`, `header_badge_pty` were quarantined out of the gate (#1414, #1423, #1470) — quarantined suites do not run, so they contribute nothing. Per-line attribution is exactly what the per-PR `pty-integration-linux` + `pty-coverage-gate` legs compute authoritatively.

## New tests — module → what each defends
| Module (lib/src/cli/) | Tests defend |
|---|---|
| `text_format.dart` | `formatArgs` 100-col cap boundary (exactly 100 untouched; 101+ → 100 chars + `...`), JSON value quoting; `safeJsonEncode` never throws — cyclic/unserializable → `[unserializable]`, lossless vs `jsonEncode` otherwise |
| `output_config.dart` | strict `output:` parser: non-map, unknown key, non-bool each throw `ConfigException` (a typo must never silently keep the default); `streamThinking` is true only when explicitly true |
| `pi_mode.dart` | AC3 precedence flag > env > config; repo truthy-env convention (case/trim; `0`/empty/null falsy); unknown `agent.mode` throws naming the value and the `default\|pi` set; `piToolsOverride` pins every known tool id to `piToolIds` membership and cannot grant unknown tools |
| `tui_mouse_mode.dart` | parse boundaries: `1/true/yes/on` → on, `0/false/no` → off, null/empty/`y`/`enabled` → auto (default) |
| `ask_menu.dart` | header + 1-based progress suffix only when total > 1; `(Recommended)` on exactly the recommended row; blank description renders like none; `pickedLabel` sorted, 1-based, `-` when empty |
| `browser_bridge_commands.dart` | null handle → clean unavailable note on every subcommand; unknown subcommand and non-numeric port refused BEFORE any connect (fake handle counts calls); port/`--copy-keys` pass through to the handle; already-running vs started wording; a throwing connect surfaces a line, not a crash; status renders endpoint/extensions/mailboxes incl. cwd-less rows |
| `links_surface.dart` | block renders all three URLs and the coming-soon slot exactly twice while `play` is unset; live Play link replaces it; config values are attribute-escaped (a hostile link cannot break out of `href`); header badge + hero CTA carry ONLY the paid link with their per-position referral values |
| `provider_tuning_seed.dart` | tuned entry registers and the boot notice pins name, endpoint, sources; endpoint-keyed resolution (request URL under the base → `provider:<name>`, other host → built-in 180s/300s); per-field fallthrough (connect set → idle stays `default`); AC6 fast path (no overrides → never registered); E4 `reset: true` drops removed entries; without reset the seeder adds (boot two-pass) |

## Local gate status — honest disclosure
This host's machine guard SIGKILLs dart VM runs (exit 137). Attempted ONCE from the worktree, as sanctioned: `dart test <the 8 new files>` via the bundled dart-sdk binary (the PATH `dart` is a flutter shim that cannot write its engine stamp on this sandboxed host) → **killed, exit 137**. Nothing was measured locally; no output is faked.

Static fallback applied (the PR#1557 lesson): every import path verified to exist; every referenced symbol grep-verified as defined in its module; directive order verified (imports precede declarations); flutter_test-only matchers removed (`findsNWidgets` → RegExp count — root-package tests stay Flutter-free); one compile error caught and fixed pre-push (`const` on the non-const factory `StoreBannerView.from`). The PR's own CI is the real gate.

## Delivered vs remaining
Delivered: baseline file at 17.96, #927 trace, 8 test files / 729 lines, static gate clean.
Remaining (owner-side by design): the per-PR `pty-integration-linux` + `pty-coverage-gate` runs — SM owns CI scheduling (no workflow dispatch from this lane per fleet policy).
